name: Skeptic
reason: History says every past August had a bloom and the satellite index is rising, but a cool-ish 27.1 C with zero hot days and 29.7 mm of fresh rain mixing and diluting the lake leaves me unwilling to call it settled.
evidence: bloom_rate_this_month_past_years = 1.0, but that is a base rate, not this week's observation
cyano_index 0.171, up only 0.036 vs last week, a modest rise that is not clearly a bloom
hot_days = 0 with max_temp_avg 27.1 C, so no heat-driven surge
rain_total_mm 29.7 this week and 50.7 mm over 14 days with 3 heavy rain days, which means mixing and dilution, though also nutrient runoff
